udp_like_status.fec_status: Release wire path remains off or fixed systematic 20:20 unless an explicit future ADR changes it. Research formula work must not silently change the live wire profile.
udp_like_status.capacity_policy: ADR-0010 release authority remains 40 Mbit/s aggregate inner on <=100 Mbit/s physical weak-link qualification.
udp_like_status.link_speed_policy: Automatic and manual link-speed authorities remain distinct; manual must work without an automatic sample, and capacity estimation remains separate from loss/burst statistics.

product_policy.link_setup: Reality-like TLS front remains setup/admission only; sustained payload remains WBD FakeTCP -> pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 -> immutable LINK.
product_policy.accounts: One shared username/password may authenticate multiple simultaneous devices; routing/session state is ticket/LiveID/peer keyed, never username keyed.
product_policy.fullcone_nat: OpenWrt UDP remains endpoint-independent mapping plus endpoint-independent filtering with root-qualified hairpin/NAT-loopback coverage. This is platform behavior, not transport semantics.
product_policy.windows_gui: Final Windows product is a portable outer wbd.exe runnable from an arbitrary directory. wbd.json and cn4.txt/cn6.txt/cn-manifest.json live beside the outer executable. The GUI exposes Npcap install/repair but does not redistribute the Npcap Free Edition binaries. Minimize/X hides to tray and keeps VPN running; explicit Disconnect stops the tunnel; explicit Exit performs automatic cleanup then terminates. Connect fails closed if the device-wide IPv6 kill-switch cannot be established. While connected, IPv6 is blocked for the whole device with WBD-owned firewall rules; cleanup removes those rules. GUI lifecycle calls windowsruntime rather than embedding transport logic in the UI thread.
product_policy.windows_routing_dns: IPv4 product policy exposes Full, Foreign (foreign through WBD with CN direct), and China (CN through WBD) using a verified portable CN bundle. DNS policy supports Auto/System/Cloudflare/Custom; Full/Foreign Auto use WBD-owned NRPT plus resolver host routes, while China Auto retains system DNS. IPv6 is not split-routed: it is blocked device-wide while WBD is connected.
product_policy.linux_server: The product exposes exactly one public WBD_PORT shared by Reality-like admission and raw FakeTCP. Internal LINK/platform/DTLS worker ports remain loopback/internal implementation details. The release manager owns install/uninstall/start/stop/pause/resume/restart/status/logs/config/set/regen-certs/doctor/show-config. Install enables but does not auto-start until configuration is reviewed. nftables/iptables cleanup removes only WBD-owned rules/state and never flushes or restores the entire host ruleset.
product_policy.settings_testing: Every exposed routing, DNS, CN bundle, server port/domain/credential/session, game/link-speed/FEC/lane/pacing setting must retain executable validation; do not regress previously green product settings gates.
